FN-3PPUAZV-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 334
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative Jeremy Gray
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/01/2025
House Bill 334 as introduced would increase the costs of: (1) the State Employees' Health
Insurance Plan (SEHIP) by an estimated $200,000 annually; and (2) the Public Education
Employees Health Insurance Plan (PEEHIP) by an estimated $160,000 annually by requiring
certain health benefit plans to offer an annual prostate cancer early detection screening to high
risk males without cost-sharing requirements.
Page 1

FN-3PPUAZV-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 334
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative Jeremy Gray
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/09/2025
House Bill 334 as introduced would increase the costs of: (1) the State Employees' Health
Insurance Plan (SEHIP) by a maximum of $200,000 annually; and (2) the Public Education
Employees Health Insurance Plan (PEEHIP) by a maximum of $160,000 annually by requiring
certain health benefit plans to offer an annual prostate cancer early detection screening to certain
men without cost-sharing requirements.
